notes.title: New image gallery!
notes.content:
Based on your many requests, we added an[b] image gallery[/b] to the game, featuring all the images you unlocked from the game. You can find the gallery from the main menu and if you completed the game already - you don't need to play it again, the gallery should be full right away!
Enjoy and have a merry Christmas!

notes.title: Small update - window resizing
notes.content: Based on the player feedback we fixed the resizing of a window. You can play in a full screen mode or in a windowed mode which you can resize and all the UI and game elements should be visible all the time.
